title: Why Do We Need Eyebrows?
hook: Eyebrows are rain and sweat guards.
narration: Eyebrows are rain and sweat guards.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do We Need Eyebrows.
They also flash feelings across a room.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Raise them. We read surprise without a word.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
A tiny roof for your eyes, plus a signal flag.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Eyebrows are rain and sweat guards.
The pictures today are a new eye world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do we need eyebrows.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
